items.title: Using Hotwire With Rails — Ruby on Rails Guides
items.summary: Hotwire is Rails' default JavaScript front-end stack. This guide covers Rails' integration with the Hotwire libraries Turbo and Stimulus.After reading this guide you will know: The libraries that the Hotwire suite consists of. What Turbo is, and how to use Turbo Drive, Turbo Frames, and Turbo Stream
